purpose: Teach: よら/云っ/よろしけれ/ぶち/つぶれ/とどまら/創る/ココロ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに何かよらない事があったらしいわ
lines.en: Sho, it seems Dad had something bothering him today.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact observation. Warm undercurrent — she's not alarmed, just noting it. Light, conversational pace. The tone of someone used to reading her family.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「ありがとう」と云ってくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said thank you to me.
lines.style: Bright, genuine pride in his small voice. A little surprise underneath — he's offering this like a gift. Quiet warmth, no performance. The pleasure of being noticed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、もしよろしければ、宿題のお手伝いするわよ
lines.en: Sho, if you'd like, I can help you with your homework.
lines.style: Practical offer wrapped in gentleness. No fuss. The kind of steady support that doesn't need ceremony. Warm but not hovering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「ぶち」抜きで本気で話したよ
lines.en: Mom, I talked to Dad really honestly — just the two of us.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his own courage. A little shy about admitting it mattered. Soft but steady. The voice of a child who did something hard and is still catching his breath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、おもちゃが壊れてつぶれちゃったわね
lines.en: Sho, your toy got broken and crushed, didn't it.
lines.style: Dry, affectionate noting of the obvious. Not a question — she saw. Light wry humor underneath the sympathy. The rhythm of someone who knows her son's accidents.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんを困らせるところにとどまらない、もっと優しくするよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm not just going to stop upsetting Dad — I'm going to be kinder to him.
lines.style: Soft but firm resolution. Not bragging — stating what he's decided. Careful, thoughtful pacing. The voice of a child who's understood something important and is holding it gently.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家族の絆を創るって仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying that he wants to build the family's bond stronger.
lines.style: Reflective, nodding at what she's heard. Warm recognition. Slower pace — she's letting this land. The voice of someone seeing her partner's heart in what he said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんを「ココロから」尊敬してるよ
lines.en: Mom, I really respect Dad — from my heart.
lines.style: Soft, heartfelt. No performance. Almost whispered with the weight of genuine feeling. A child's simple honesty. Slight breath before the final phrase — he's meaning every word.
